cat << 'PYEOF' | ssh autodl-5090 "cat > /tmp/plot_fig1.py"
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

df = pd.read_csv('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/features_all_models.csv')

model_display = {
    'pythia-2.8b': 'Pythia-2.8B',
    'pythia-1b': 'Pythia-1B',
    'olmo-2-1b': 'OLMo-2-1B',
    'qwen3-1.7b': 'Qwen3-1.7B',
    'qwen3-0.6b': 'Qwen3-0.6B',
    'qwen3-8b': 'Qwen3-8B',
}

model_colors = {
    'pythia-2.8b': '#0072B2',
    'pythia-1b': '#56B4E9',
    'olmo-2-1b': '#009E73',
    'qwen3-1.7b': '#D55E00',
    'qwen3-0.6b': '#E69F00',
    'qwen3-8b': '#CC79A7',
}

model_order = ['pythia-2.8b', 'pythia-1b', 'olmo-2-1b', 'qwen3-1.7b', 'qwen3-0.6b', 'qwen3-8b']

panels = [
    ('entropy_mean', '(a) entropy_mean', 'Drifting'),
    ('hapax_ratio', '(b) hapax_ratio', 'Drifting'),
    ('entropy_std', '(c) entropy_std', 'Stationary'),
    ('tail_decay', '(d) tail_decay', 'Stationary'),
]

depths = sorted(df['depth'].unique())

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(7, 6))
axes = axes.flatten()

legend_handles = []
legend_labels = []

for idx, (feat, title, category) in enumerate(panels):
    ax = axes[idx]
    
    for model in model_order:
        mdf = df[df['model_name'] == model]
        if mdf.empty:
            continue
        
        means = []
        ci_lo = []
        ci_hi = []
        
        for d in depths:
            vals = mdf[mdf['depth'] == d][feat].dropna().values
            if len(vals) == 0:
                means.append(np.nan)
                ci_lo.append(np.nan)
                ci_hi.append(np.nan)
                continue
            
            m = np.mean(vals)
            means.append(m)
            
            # SEM-based 95% CI
            sem = np.std(vals, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(vals))
            ci_lo.append(m - 1.96 * sem)
            ci_hi.append(m + 1.96 * sem)
        
        means = np.array(means)
        ci_lo = np.array(ci_lo)
        ci_hi = np.array(ci_hi)
        
        line, = ax.plot(depths, means, 'o-', color=model_colors[model],
                       markersize=4, label=model_display[model])
        ax.fill_between(depths, ci_lo, ci_hi, color=model_colors[model], alpha=0.12)
        
        if idx == 0:
            legend_handles.append(line)
            legend_labels.append(model_display[model])
    
    ax.set_title(title, fontweight='bold', pad=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('Generation Depth')
    ax.set_ylabel(feat.replace('_', ' ').title() if feat != 'ttr' else 'TTR')
    ax.set_xticks(depths)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f'gen-{d}' for d in depths])
    
    # Category badge
    bbox_color = '#FFE0E0' if category == 'Drifting' else '#E0F0E0'
    text_color = '#CC0000' if category == 'Drifting' else '#006600'
    ax.text(0.98, 0.95, category, transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha='right', va='top', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
            color=text_color,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=bbox_color,
                     edgecolor=text_color, alpha=0.8, linewidth=0.8))

fig.legend(legend_handles, legend_labels, loc='lower center',
           ncol=6, frameon=False, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02))

plt.tight_layout()
fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.1)

out_base = '/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/figures/paper/fig1_differential_response'
fig.savefig(out_base + '.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(out_base + '.png', format='png', dpi=300)
print(f'Saved: {out_base}.pdf and {out_base}.png')
PYEOF
